result.paraphrase: Gigabyte AORUS Gen4 M.2 SSD, 500GB (5000MBps/2500MBps). Description: Brand GIGABYTE, model GP-ASM2NE6500GTTD, internal solid state drive for consumer use. M.2 2280 form factor with 500GB capacity and 3D TLC Toshiba BiCS4 memory. Uses PCI-Express 4.0 x4 and NVMe 1.3, with a Phison PS5016-E16 controller and 512MB DDR4 cache. Performance: up to 5000 MBps sequential read, up to 2500 MBps sequential write, 400,000 IOPS 4KB random read, and 550,000 IOPS 4KB random write; MTTF is 1.77 million hours. Includes a heatsink, wear leveling and over-provisioning technologies, TRIM and S.M.A.R.T. support, and a fully body copper heat spreader. Environmental specs: 13.21 mW idle power, 5.9W read and 4.5W write active power, 0°C to +70°C operating temperature, and -40°C to +85°C storage temperature. Dimensions are 11.40mm high, 23.50mm wide, and 80.50mm deep. First available August 07, 2019.
